metadata.title: Clicked like my mouse owed the enemy a favor and somehow got that 1 clueless kill
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like I was smashing bugs in real life.
Enemy probably questioning their existence.
Pretending I meant that for 0.17 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a happy accident but kills sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess but kills still roll in!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
